verdict.rationale: LM Studio is inherently self-hosted: it runs entirely on the user's own machine, offers a headless 'llmster' mode explicitly for servers/CI without a GUI, a REST API, and CLI commands to start/stop a local server and serve models on the network (lm-studio-docs-5, -8, -9, -12). Community members confirm running it as a local/headless inference backend for real tools (lm-studio-comm-17), though some report friction setting up network access (lm-studio-comm-16) and wish for a leaner daemon mode (lm-studio-comm-13). Missing for 10: clearer first-party network-configuration docs and more independent verification of smooth headless/CI deployment.
